LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This is a standard -bin PKGBUILD for the AstrBot desktop application. It downloads prebuilt .deb packages from the project's own GitHub releases page (the declared upstream URL) and verifies them with pinned SHA-256 checksums. The LICENSE source is pinned to a specific upstream commit hash. The package() function extracts only the data payload from the .deb using bsdtar and explicitly avoids executing Debian maintainer scripts, which is a security best practice that prevents rogue pre/post-install scripts from running as root. No obfuscation, eval, curl/wget pipeline execution, data exfiltration, or unexpected system modifications are present. The operations are consistent with ordinary AUR packaging for prebuilt binaries.
</details>
